label: Pantua
note: The Bengali analogue of gulab jamun, made from chhena and semolina rather than khoa; Ledikeni is a lightly fried, syrup-filled kin

about.text: Pantua is a Bengali sweet of deep-fried balls of chhena, semolina, milk and ghee soaked in sugar syrup, from pale brown to nearly black depending on how long it is fried.

how.label: knead, fry, soak in syrup
how.text: Unlike rasgulla the balls are fried before the syrup, which browns them.
